chapter_title: Learning Experience Design and Software Technology
title: Interaction Patterns for Learning Software
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting interaction patterns for learning software to storyboard frame sequence with narration, signaling, and reader-action notes, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Match a cognitive operation (compare, sequence, decide, observe) to the interaction pattern whose structure enacts it (interaction-cognition fit)
Diagnose an interaction for split attention, seductive detail, or interaction-cost asymmetry
Verify that an interaction closes its loop with a visible consequence and stays equitable for keyboard and screen-reader learners
Defend a pattern choice with behavioral evidence and a named rejected alternative rather than production value

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
